question: Which subset of the seven response sites omitted by the over-compressed three-MLP program restores its fresh temporal mode-2 deficit while preserving both tasks?

authority.interpretation: This is explicitly outcome-adaptive discovery on v12. Any selected augmentation requires a new text-disjoint construction before it can be called transferable.

frozen_design.population: The identical 24 temporal and 30 is/was v12 rows used by the registered transfer null.
frozen_design.arms: The complete 2^7 Boolean lattice of optional-site subsets, always retaining the three-site core. Six fixed diagnostic aliases repeat direct/core/full/core-minus-one arms for continuity with the sealed evaluator.
frozen_design.eligibility: Behavior direction at least 0.90; behavior signed projection at least 0.80 per task; both mode signed projections at least 0.60 per task; worst six-cell squared residual at most 0.20.
frozen_design.selector: Among eligible cube arms, minimize optional-site count, then worst six-cell residual, then integer mask.

predictions.pred_a_authority_replay_finiteness_and_e: Fresh-null hashes and the inherited gauge/replay/self-clamp instruments pass, with the exact registered price.
predictions.pred_b_full_ten_site_pool_remains_faithf: The full optional mask has behavior direction at least 0.95 and worst six-cell residual at most 0.02.
predictions.pred_c_a_six_site_or_smaller_program_exi: At least one eligible arm adds no more than three optional sites to the core.
predictions.pred_d_selector_is_deterministic_and_eli: The frozen lexicographic selector returns exactly one eligible mask and its stored sites equal core union mask bits.
predictions.pred_e_complete_zero_fit_augmentation_la: All 128 masks are present exactly once and no fitting, model update, or transformer backward occurs.

decision: All gates yield compact_augmented_response_discovery and license only a fresh confirmation of the selected mask. Instrument failure yields invalid. Other failures yield distributed_response_program; the ten-site pool remains the accepted upper bound if its fidelity gate passes.
